acceptanceCriteria: Failing tests are named from a reproduced loaded run.
Fixtures use condition or event waits, or deadlines scaled without weakening what is asserted.
The tests pass 20 consecutive runs under a saturating load.
body: Context: Go 1.27.1, Darwin arm64, 2026-10-04, origin/main 8a3e3a5b. The PSR (pool sweep, PSR-V0-*) store tests in internal/tasks/store flaked on a heavily loaded host and passed when run alone. Item 11 (#498 store tests sensitive to host load: PSR reconcile/dispatch tests in internal/tasks/store) appears to be the same family and is merged here; confirm when diagnosing. Suspected, not confirmed: timing-based waits or fixed deadlines in the fixtures. Related prior load-flake tickets: V1-0395, V1-0455, V1-0636. Reproduce: run go test -count=1 ./internal/tasks/store/ concurrently with a CPU-saturating load, then rerun alone. Expected: deterministic under load (event/condition waits, not wall-clock). Actual: intermittent failures under load, pass alone. The failing test names were not retained.
title: PSR pool-sweep and reconcile/dispatch store tests are sensitive to host load (merges item 11, #498)
